elements.label: Words 'Every' and 'note' collapsing into the icon
App icon morphing into a text caret

pattern.description: The two words slide inward and disappear behind the central app icon, then the icon narrows into a thin vertical bar that settles left of centre as a blinking text caret, setting up a typed prompt.
pattern.why_premium: The brand icon literally becomes the input cursor, turning the logo into the next UI state with no cut; the words being swallowed by the icon reads as the product absorbing the content.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.word-left', {x: 120, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.in'}).to('.word-right', {x: -120, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.in'}, '<').to('.icon', {width: 6, height: 56, borderRadius: 1, x: -120, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power3.inOut'}, '-=0.05') (words clipped behind the icon via overflow mask)
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 30, stiffness: 220, mass: 1}}); word translateX = interpolate(p, [0, 1], [0, +/-120]); icon width = interpolate(frame, [10, 17], [80, 6], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic), extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) and translateX to the caret position.

notes: Words exit is mostly hidden behind the icon (occlusion) rather than fading; b02 is used for both words together since neither has its own box in the end frame. Icon-to-caret is read as a morph; it may instead be a fast scale-down plus a separate caret fade-in. b03 OCR '1' is the caret.
